projections.source_time_basis: HYCOM00Z2022instantaneous full sections;fixed315degree northwest component and complete surface-connected0–200m integral selector. Two snapshots are not an annual cycle or observed monthly means.
projections.projection_gate: Interior full-section integral maximum with finite neighboring upper-layer support and resolved primary10cm/s lower contour; no independent named-current-axis validation.
projections.interpolation_assumption: Connect all original selected full-section model-axis proxy positions in declared section order with shortest WGS84 reference legs. At exact eligible nodes retain the primary10cm/s descriptor;between neighboring eligible original nodes only assume linear lower depth and paired upper depth/model layer span. Preserve censored original nodes and adjacent gaps,no skipping or extrapolation. Coordinates are reference geometry,not an observed axis or measured whole-current length.
